hints.content: On a  number line, numbers to the right are greater than numbers to the left.
The values of $\goldD{-2}$,  $\maroonD{1}$, and $\blueD{4}$  are to the right of  $\redD{-5}$.
The values that make the inequality true are $\goldD{-2}$,  $\maroonD{1}$, and $\blueD{4}$.
